design: Frozen scalar/block/shared-group models all3seeds, all3degree-null rewires per dictionary, fixed/adaptive writePCA8 and3randomTopK8 controls. Reuse H732five-task/two-format panel including known native failures and nuisance changes. Capture L5H3/H5 final-position heads; apply F(donor)-F(receiver) only at final position, two reciprocal task directions, one nuisance and one identity. No retraining or task-based model/seed selection. Full-head reference for every edit.
relative_error_gate: Native family/format competence pass AND full-head margin-change RMS>=0.25logits; otherwise absolute RMS only. All cells retained.
limitations: Research-panel reuse, not entirely new tasks/prompts. New application of these frozen L5featurizers. Final-position only, unlike earlier two-position operation tests. Diverse full-head effects, no downstream Q/K clamp. Ratios across small/correlated panels descriptive.
